def segs_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    segs=[]; seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            c=g[i][j]; comp=[]; st=[(i,j)]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=c: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
            if len(comp)<2: continue
            fam='a' if all(a+b==comp[0][0]+comp[0][1] for a,b in comp) else 'd'
            segs.append({'c':c,'fam':fam,'cells':set(comp)})
    return bg,segs
